title: Senior Technical Lead
description:
**Job Description: SAP MM Functional Consultant (SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud Edition SaaS - Greenfield Implementation)**
  
**Position Title:** SAP MM Functional Consultant
  
**Location:** Patna, Bihar (Customer Site)
  
**Customer:** Government DISCOM (Power Distribution Utility)
  
**Project Type:** SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud Edition (PCE) SaaS Greenfield Implementation
  
**Experience Required:** 10+ Years Relevant Experience
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time
  
**Role Overview**
  
We are seeking a highly experienced **SAP Materials Management (MM) Functional Consultant** to participate in a large-scale **SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud Edition (PCE) Greenfield Implementation** for a Government Power Distribution Utility (DISCOM).
  
The consultant will be responsible for business process consulting, solution design, configuration, testing, user training, and deployment of SAP MM processes, ensuring alignment with utility industry best practices and government procurement regulations. The role requires extensive experience in procurement, inventory management, warehouse operations, material valuation, and integration with other SAP modules.
  
The consultant will work onsite at the customer location in Patna and collaborate with business users, project stakeholders, and implementation teams throughout the project lifecycle.
  
**Key Responsibilities**
  
**Business Process Consulting**

* Conduct business process workshops and requirement gathering sessions with DISCOM stakeholders.
* Analyze existing procurement and inventory management processes.
* Map business requirements to SAP S/4HANA MM best practices.
* Prepare Business Blueprint, Functional Design Documents (FDD), and process flow diagrams.
* Recommend process improvements leveraging SAP S/4HANA capabilities.

**SAP MM Solution Design & Configuration**
  
Configure and support SAP S/4HANA MM processes including:
  
**Procurement Management**

* Purchase Requisition Management
* Request for Quotation (RFQ)
* Vendor Quotation Processing
* Purchase Order Processing
* Contract Management
* Outline Agreements
* Rate Contracts
* Service Procurement
* Emergency Procurement

**Inventory Management**

* Goods Receipt
* Goods Issue
* Stock Transfer
* Material Reservation
* Physical Inventory
* Inventory Reconciliation
* Batch Management
* Stock Monitoring

**Warehouse & Stores Operations**

* Warehouse Management Processes
* Material Tracking
* Bin Management
* Material Movement Monitoring
* Spare Parts Management
* Utility Stores Management

**Material Master Management**

* Material Creation and Governance
* Classification
* Valuation
* Material Grouping
* Coding Standards
* Master Data Harmonization

**Utility Procurement Process Implementation**
  
Support procurement processes related to:

* Transformers
* Meters and Smart Meters
* Conductors and Cables
* Switchgear Equipment
* Distribution Assets
* Maintenance Spares
* Capital Project Materials
* Consumables and Operational Inventory

Implement procurement workflows aligned with Government and Utility procurement policies.
  
**Integration Responsibilities**
  
Work closely with functional and technical teams for integration with:
  
**SAP FI/CO**

* Account Determination
* Material Valuation
* Invoice Verification
* Budget Controls

**SAP EAM / PM**

* Maintenance Spare Procurement
* Maintenance Inventory Management
* Work Order Material Consumption

**SAP PS**

* Project Procurement
* Capital Project Material Tracking
* WBS Based Procurement

**SAP SD**

* Intercompany Stock Transfers
* Material Availability Management

**SAP Ariba (if applicable)**

* Supplier Collaboration
* Strategic Sourcing
* Procurement Automation

**SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud Implementation Activities**

* Participate in Fit-to-Standard workshops.
* Configure SAP S/4HANA MM solutions using SAP Activate methodology.
* Prepare configuration documents and functional specifications.
* Review RICEFW objects impacting MM processes.
* Support SAP Best Practices implementation.
* Assist with data migration activities.

**Data Migration**

* Material Master Migration
* Vendor Master Migration
* Open Purchase Orders
* Inventory Balances
* Contracts and Scheduling Agreements

**Activities include:**

* Data Assessment
* Cleansing
* Validation
* Mock Migration
* Cutover Support
* Reconciliation

**Testing Responsibilities**
  
Lead and support:

* Unit Testing
* System Integration Testing (SIT)
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Regression Testing
* Cutover Testing

**Responsibilities include:**

* Test Script Preparation
* Defect Resolution
* Business Validation
* Go-Live Readiness Support

**Training & Knowledge Transfer**

* Conduct end-user training programs.
* Develop training manuals and SOPs.
* Prepare process documentation.
* Facilitate change management activities.
* Support post-go-live knowledge transfer.

**Go-Live & Hypercare Support**

* Support cutover execution.
* Resolve production issues.
* Monitor procurement and inventory transactions.
* Assist business users during stabilization phase.
* Ensure successful transition to support teams.

**Required Qualifications**
  
**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Commerce, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* MBA in Operations/Supply Chain Management preferred.

**Experience Requirements**

* Minimum 10+ years of SAP MM consulting experience.
* Minimum 2 end-to-end SAP implementation projects.
* Minimum 1 SAP S/4HANA Greenfield implementation project.
* Experience in SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud Edition implementation preferred.
* Experience working with Government, PSU, Utilities, Power Sector, or DISCOM organizations preferred.
* Experience managing large-scale procurement and inventory processes.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**
  
**SAP MM Functional Expertise**

* Procurement Lifecycle Management
* Inventory Management
* Material Master Management
* Invoice Verification
* Release Strategies
* Valuation and Account Determination
* Physical Inventory
* Subcontracting
* Consignment Processes
* Service Procurement

**SAP S/4HANA Knowledge**

* SAP S/4HANA Procurement
* SAP Fiori Applications
* Business Partner Integration
* Embedded Analytics
* SAP Activate Methodology
* SAP Best Practices

**Integration Knowledge**

* SAP FI/CO
* SAP EAM/PM
* SAP PS
* SAP SD
* SAP Ariba (Preferred)
* SAP MDG (Preferred)

**Preferred Certifications**

* SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement
* SAP S/4HANA Procurement Certification
* SAP Activate Project Certification
* SAP Ariba Procurement Certification

**Preferred Domain Experience**
  
Candidates with experience in the following sectors will be preferred:

* Power Distribution Utilities (DISCOM)
* State Electricity Boards (SEB)
* Electricity Transmission & Distribution
* Energy & Utilities
* Government ERP Projects
* Public Sector Undertakings (PSU)
* Infrastructure Projects

**Key Competencies**

* Strong Functional Consulting Skills
* Requirement Gathering & Process Mapping
* Stakeholder Management
* Business Process Transformation
* Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills
* Documentation and Presentation Skills
* Client-Facing Communication
* Team Collaboration
* Change Management Support

**Reporting Structure**
  
**Reports To:** SAP MM Lead / Solution Architect / Project Manager
  
**Key Stakeholders:**

* DISCOM Procurement Department
* Materials & Stores Department
* Finance Department
* Asset Management Team
* PMO Team
* Government Nodal Officers
* SAP Project Leadership

**Location Requirement**

* **Work Location:** Patna, Bihar (Customer Premises)
* Full-time onsite deployment during project implementation.
* Willingness to travel to field offices, warehouses, divisional stores, and utility locations within the DISCOM operational area as required.

**Success Criteria**

* Successful implementation of SAP S/4HANA MM processes.
* Seamless integration with Finance, Asset Management, and Project Systems.
* Accurate inventory and procurement data migration.
* Compliance with Government procurement policies and audit requirements.
* User adoption and operational efficiency improvements.
* Stable and successful go-live with minimal business disruption.

Qualifications

Graduate

Range of Year Experience-Min Year

10

Range of Year Experience-Max Year

15
